title: CUMBERLAND PHARMACEUTICALS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting shareholder voting results from its April 21, 2026 annual meeting. Shareholders approved the election of two Class I directors, ratified Carr, Riggs & Ingram LLC as the independent accounting firm, and approved executive compensation arrangements.
key_points: Annual shareholder meeting held April 21, 2026 in Nashville, Tennessee
Shareholders elected Kenneth J. Krogulski (99.52% in favor) and Caroline R. Young (98.66% in favor) as Class I directors
Appointment of Carr, Riggs & Ingram LLC as independent auditor for 2026 approved with 99.82% in favor
Advisory vote on executive compensation approved with 99.82% in favor
Shareholders voted on frequency of say-on-pay votes (every year, every other year, or every three years); 'Every Three Years' received majority
